name: How much does window replacement cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does window replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of window replacement varies widely based on several factors, including the number and size of windows, the chosen material (e.g., vinyl, wood, fiberglass), glass type (e.g., double-pane, low-E), installation complexity, and labor rates. Custom shapes or specific energy-efficient features will also impact the price. It's best to obtain a detailed estimate from a reputable contractor after an on-site evaluation to get an accurate cost for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on window count, size, material, glass type, and installation complexity. Get a detailed estimate for your specific project.
